_about: Public-domain Félix Dupanloup (1802-1878, Bishop of Orleans) in English for the Word Hoard: The Papal Sovereignty (1860), The Future Oecumenical Council (1869), the Minghetti letter on the spoliation of the Church (1874), The Child, tr. Kate Anderson (1875), A Study of Freemasonry (1876), The Ministry of Preaching, tr. Samuel J. Eales (1890), and The Ministry of Catechising (preface dated 1890), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 29 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

dupanloup-future-council: The Future Oecumenical Council: a letter by the Bishop of Orleans, tr. Henry S. Butterfield and E. Robillard (London: R. Washbourne, 1869)
dupanloup-minghetti-letter: Letter from the Lord Bishop of Orleans to M. Minghetti on the Spoliation of the Church (London: Burns and Oates, 1874)
dupanloup-the-child: The Child, tr. Kate Anderson (Boston: Patrick Donahoe, 1875)
dupanloup-freemasonry: A Study of Freemasonry (New York: D. & J. Sadlier, 1876)
dupanloup-ministry-preaching: The Ministry of Preaching, tr. Samuel J. Eales (London: Griffith Farran Okeden & Welsh, 1890)
dupanloup-ministry-catechising: The Ministry of Catechising (London: Griffith Farran Okeden & Welsh; no year, translator's preface dated Christmas 1890)

_alternates.dupanloup-copies: Other copies of each; The Child (Noonan, undated)
